common_generating_values: Part 1 full four-chain individual posterior medians; used only as simulation generating constants, not empirical priors or heldout training posterior

weak.individual_effects: Original strong-case beta values shifted by -0.45; between-participant heterogeneity unchanged
weak.scope: Weak population mean, not zero individual heterogeneity

prior_predictive_scope: Limited pre-existing checks, not exhaustive prior-space validation; recorded floating-point rounding flags are retained
limits: Different effect settings are not iid repetitions; cannot report a precise identification probability or claim recovery at all parameter values. Synthetic observation rule is ordinary untruncated joint choice/RT generation.
